newsitem.title: USA: Dow hits another high; 10th so far this month.
newsitem.headline: Dow hits another high; 10th so far this month.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average Wednesday jumped to yet another record high -- its 10th so far in November -- in a rally driven by big gains in the shares of IBM, General Motors, Caterpillar and Boeing.

Based on early and unofficial data, the 30-share index rose 32.42 points to close at 6,430.02, beating Tuesday's record of 6,397.60. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a 13-10 margin on active volume of 492 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
